tagline: The gateway to the hero corridor — Bali → Lombok → Komodo → Sumba.
summary: Bali is the entry point to Southeast Asia's premier luxury island-hopping chain. Close-in, Pioneer II handles the busy Nusa Penida / Lembongan and Gili day-trip hops that today mean rough, crowded fast-boats; reaching out, Quanta-LR's hybrid range opens the marquee Bali → Lombok → Komodo → Sumba corridor as a sequence of smooth single legs.
